svg.title: Amber self-consume: pile limit up to 16 kW, EV takes 0.7 kW, BESS absorbs the PV
svg.desc: Top: PV, home battery and EV pile power with the DC pile charge limit written by Amber and the ESS max charging limit of 0. Bottom: EV pile power at 1 s with the running-state reversals.
svg.text: Amber self-consume: pile limit up to 16 kW, EV takes 0.7 kW, BESS absorbs the PV
27 Oct 2026 12:15:38–13:22:23 AEST · Remote EMS off (Amber V2X in control) · M3P on the DC pile at 72–73 %, car limit 95 % · 30-s means
ESS max charging limit = 0 kW since 12:10:26 (red dotted) — the BESS still charges at up to 17.8 kW
EV pile at 5 s · red ticks = switch to Discharging · 103 reversals in 66 min, median hold 10 s, DC discharge limit 0
The DC pile charge limit Amber wrote would have allowed about 11.9 kWh into the EV over the same window.
